newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Electrolux raises Hungary unit capital by HUF6bln.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux raises Hungary unit capital by HUF6bln.

text.p: Sweden's Electrolux decided to raise the registered capital of its Hungarian refrigerator producer unit by six billion forints ($33.23 million), the Hungarian news agency MTI said on Friday.
The capital increase should help Electrolux-Lehel, the subsidiary, to boost its export sales, MTI quoted CEO Tibor Kertesz as saying.
MTI did not disclose how much Electrolux-Lehel's registered capital would be following the capital increase.
Kertesz said the company's turnover totalled 47 billion forints ($260.03 million) in 1996 and the company produced 1.1 million refrigerators last year.
He added that Electrolux-Lehel expected its share in Hungary's industrial exports to rise to eight percent after the capital increase from between four and five percent.
